reason: A cyberpunk visual theme for the DeepSeek Harness web interface with customizable local backgrounds and a persistent local music-player HUD.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供赛博朋克视觉主题、可自定义的本地背景图库和本地音乐播放器。
summaries.en: Adds a cyberpunk theme to the DeepSeek Harness web interface with customizable local backgrounds and a local music player.

capabilities: Modifies the DeepSeek Harness web interface appearance
Provides selectable and locally added background images
Reads and plays user-selected local audio files
Persists appearance, background, playlist, and playback preferences locally
